sn3.1:1.2: ekam samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2.
sn3.1:1.3: Atha kho rājā Pasenadi-Kosalo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn3.1:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārānīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || 3. Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho rājā Pasenadi-kosalo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn3.1:1.5: Bhavam pi no Gotamo anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhim abhisambuddho ti patijānātīti || || 4.
sn3.1:1.6: Yaṃ hi taṃ mahārāja sammāvadamāno vadeyya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhim abhisambuddho ti maman-taṃ sammāvadamāno vadeyya ||
sn3.1:1.7: ahaṃ hi mahārāja anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhim abhisambuddho ti || || 5.
sn3.1:2.1: Ye pi te bho Gotama samaṇa-brāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhu sammatā bahujanassa || seyyathīdaṃ
sn3.1:2.2: Puraṇo-Kassapo Makkhali-Gosālo Nigaṇṭho Nāṭaputto Sañjayo-belaṭṭhaputto Kakudho Kaccāyano Ajito-kesakambalo ||
sn3.1:2.3: te pi mayā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhim abhisambuddho ti paṭijānāthāti puṭṭhā samānā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhim abhisambuddho tina paṭijānanti ||
sn3.1:2.4: kim pana bhavaṃ Gotamo daharo c-eva jātiyā navo ca pabbajāyāti || || 6.
sn3.1:3.1: Cattāro kho me magārāja daharā ti na uññātabbā daharāti na paribhotabbā ||
sn3.1:3.3: Khattiyo kho mahārāja daharo ti na uññātabbo daharo ti na paribhotabbo || ||
sn3.1:3.4: Urago kho mahārāja daharo ti na uññātabbo daharo ti na paribhotabbho || ||
sn3.1:3.5: Aggi kho mahārāja daharo ti na uññātabbo daharo ti na paribhotabbo || ||
sn3.1:3.6: Bhikkhu kho mahārāja daharo ti na uññātabbo daharo ti na paribhotabbo || ||
sn3.1:3.7: Ime kho mahārāja cattāro daharā ti na uññātabbā daharā ti na paribhotabbā ti || || 7.
sn3.1:4.2: idaṃ vatvāna Sugato athāparam etad avoca satthā || || 8.
sn3.1:14.1: Evaṃ vutte rājā Pasenadi-kosalo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn3.1:14.3: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggam ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhinti || evam evaṃ Bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito || ||
sn3.1:14.4: Esāhaṃ bhante Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammaṃ ca bhikkhusaṅghaṃ ca ||
sn3.1:14.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhante Bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti || || 1. Sāvatthiyaṃ ārāme || || 2.
